title:
We are holding some free ukulele workshops tomorrow at Ramsbottom Royal British Legion with Ramsbottom Come Together Fetstival!

The workshops are intended for both beginners looking to get into something new and will also cover techniques and skills for more advanced ukulele players!

No need to bring an instrument, borrow one of ours 🙂

https://www.rctf.co.uk/bookings/

You can book on the uke workshops and loads more here 👆 

I hope you can make it! 

Please share, thank you x
